infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Duna uses the camera to record and live stream beach volleyball.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Duna uses the microphone only when you choose to include audio in a recording or live stream.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Duna lets you choose high-resolution volleyball action photos for profile artwork and videos for your private archive or profile.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Duna reads only the Apple Health categories you choose to build private, personalized Readiness, Sleep and Strain trends, compare those patterns with your matches, and align heart rate with your Duna Vision recordings.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Duna does not write to or change Apple Health. HealthKit access is read-only so you can choose the data behind your private performance timeline, personal insights and video overlays.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Duna uses contacts you select to find frequent partners or send a one-time game invitation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Duna uses location to show nearby courts and events when you open Discover. If you choose Share trip ETA, Duna shares only a short-lived distance and ETA with your coach during the session arrival window.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: After you choose Share trip ETA, background location keeps your Lock Screen ETA current during the private arrival window. Duna stops automatically 30 minutes after the session starts and never stores raw coordinates.

plugins.photosPermission: Duna lets you select high-resolution volleyball action photos for your profile artwork.
plugins.cameraPermission: Duna uses the camera only when you choose to capture volleyball media.

plugins.calendarPermission: Duna reads calendar events you approve on this device so your matches, lessons, and personal schedule can appear together.
plugins.remindersPermission: Duna adds reminders only to confirmed bookings you choose to sync.
